name: Platinum Vape 510 Live Resin | Blue Dream
description:
A West Coast classic brought to life in live resin form. Blue Dream combines sweet blueberry notes with subtle herbal haze, delivering smooth, flavorful hits that never get old. This uplifting sativa offers a creative, energetic high that keeps the mind sharp while the body stays relaxed—perfect for daytime sessions, brainstorming, or keeping the good vibes flowing.

Strain Type: Sativa

Flavor Notes: Sweet blueberry, herbal haze, smooth finish

Effects: Uplifting, creative, energizing with light body balance
